tasks.title: Conversation #110
tasks.transcript:
Woman: So are you all set for the picnic tomorrow?
Man: Not quite. I still need to pick up some snacks and drinks and maybe a few extra napkins.
Woman: Want some help? I was planning to go to the store later anyway.
Man: That'd be perfect. I need to make a fruit salad and I'm worried I don't have enough time.
Woman: Well, it's not until the afternoon, right? And we don't have to go far.
Man: That's true. I shouldn't worry so much.

questions.stem: What does the woman offer to do?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士主动提出要做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Want some help? I was planning to go to the store later anyway. （结合上文，男士说需要买零食、饮料和餐巾纸） 选项分析： A. Provide some directions 指路。对话中未提及指路，所以A选项错误。 B. Buy some food 买些食物。女士主动提出帮忙，并说自己本来就要去商店，所以她是在帮男士购买他提到的零食、饮料等（属于食物），所以B选项正确。 C. Help with some decorations 帮忙装饰。对话中未提及装饰，所以C选项错误。 D. Send out invitations 发送邀请函。对话中未提及邀请函，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman reassure the man about?

options.A: That he has plenty of time to complete some tasks
options.B: That his recipe for fruit salad is correct
options.C: That the store will have the necessary ingredients
options.D: That the weather will be nice tomorrow

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士在哪件事上让男士放宽心？ 定位原文：Woman: Well, it's not until the afternoon, right? And we don't have to go far. （男士担心没有足够时间做水果沙拉） 选项分析： A. That he has plenty of time to complete some tasks 他有充足的时间完成一些任务。女士提醒他野餐是下午才开始，而且不用去很远的地方，暗示他时间充裕，不必担心，所以A选项正确。 B. That his recipe for fruit salad is correct 他的水果沙拉食谱是正确的。对话中未讨论食谱是否正确，所以B选项错误。 C. That the store will have the necessary ingredients 商店会有所需的食材。女士没有提到商店的库存情况，所以C选项错误。 D. That the weather will be nice tomorrow 明天天气会很好。对话中未提及天气，所以D选项错误。
